B-0112.title: Las Vegas Bikefest Rally Print
B-0112.location: North wall, 2nd row from the roll-up door
B-0112.description: Las Vegas Bikefest motorcycle rally artwork with a skull in a top hat, pistons, playing cards, dice and flames. Colors are bright. Frame has a few scuffs on the bottom edge.

B-0113.title: The Dog Park
B-0113.description: Colorful painting of many dogs playing on a green lawn, with balls, a bone and a game of tug in the middle. Black frame with a white mat.

B-0114.title: Two Racers, Indoor Track Photograph
B-0114.description: Black-and-white photograph of two vintage motorcycles racing on an indoor track. Black frame with a white mat, under glass.

B-0115.title: Favor Motorcycle Poster
B-0115.description: Poster for Favor in red, blue and yellow, with two riders on motorcycles and the French line "va droit au but". Black frame, no glass glare in this photo.
